answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust the compliance.json CP12 (issued 2025-10-17, expires 2026-10-16, Gas Safe 550123), a structured system record. The legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025' is hearsay with no dates and agrees with it. Without a new CP12 the property is non-compliant from 17 Oct.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: I opened an urgent job. I contacted the tenant on two new channels (WhatsApp and a letter) after the earlier email and SMS got no reply. I asked HeatRight, the preferred Gas Safe contractor, for slots between 12 and 15 Oct. Once a slot is confirmed I will give the tenant at least 24h written notice. I will not force entry, and holding keys gives no right of entry. I have scheduled a check on 12 Oct and will escalate if there is still no access by 14 Oct, keeping a record of every attempt to show reasonable steps.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: I told Ben (by approval request) that the certificate expires 16 Oct, that the tenant has not replied, what we have tried, that lawful access needs 24h notice, and asked him to approve HeatRight. I will call him first if the price is over £300 inc VAT.
